newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba not espcially concerned about dollar-Gaddum.
newsitem.headline: Buba not espcially concerned about dollar-Gaddum.

text.p: Bunedsbank vice-president Johann Wilhelm Gaddum said on Wednesday the German central bank was not especially concerned about the dollar's exchange rate.
"We always become watchful if the dollar moves hectically in a certain direction," Gaddum said. But this was no time when one "had to have concerns."
Buba not espcially concerned about dollar-Gaddum
The dollar's recent course was determined above all by the Japanese yen since there were expectations of an interest rate increase in Japan, he said.

Earlier on Wednesday Gaddum said at a conference on Euroepan monetary and economic union that it did not naturally follow that the future single European currency would be as stable as the deutschmark.
But he added that a solid euro would contribute to peace and stability in the region.
